pathway.title: ARCC historical five-screen Lite review
pathway.question: Which issuer-specific evidence warrants deeper analysis and what remains missing?

runs.text: The five screens complete a bounded escalation synthesis, not full underwriting. Reported NII growth, unchanged average grade, equity issuance, positive published coverage and subsequent capital-market access temper a one-way deterioration narrative. Higher nonaccrual shares, noncash recognition, illiquid marks, conditional facility access and unsecured asset-access qualifications identify the supported transmission pathway: weaker borrower realization/marks can constrain coverage or collateral eligibility, tighten funding and complicate dated refinancing. No numerical forecast, default probability, recovery or present liquidity verdict follows.

The immediate workflow questions are collected earnings versus recognition, dated funding accessibility after uses, executable convention-aligned compensation and affected legal/collateral control. ESG transmission, base/downside trajectory and market technicals remain missing-evidence requests only; this synthesis makes no favorable or adverse conclusion on those GAP_ONLY topics. C4's196.2%/46.2pp published cushion and conditional2219 ceiling difference are not cash or certified unused debt capacity. S3 already establishes selection uncertainty; Lite adds no security ranking.

runs.text: All30 canonical topics and20 four-family registers are present in canonical order. Financial and forward screens are source-direct plus bounded current handoffs; no full CP-1/2 head is fabricated. The older seven-KPI/two-quarter/10%-5% slice is not substituted for this broader family. No invented quarters, normalized EBITDA/FCF, canonical financial history, model fields, forecast, twelve-month bridge, runway, fair value, recovery, compliance, legal headroom, recommendation or size is authored. No score is assigned to securities or individuals; no governance-support inference comes from manager identity. No TDG, Frontier or Ford facts enter ARCC. Provisional confidence is qualitative, not a numeric confidence envelope or calibrated score. All upgrade outcomes are handoff requests, not automatic profile activation. Further full-owner work follows the current user-authorized sequential campaign; the imported linked-profile approval rule is historical evidence, not an additional approval requirement here.
